description: This PHP class 'DetailsToExpand' processes HTML content, particularly transforming <details> tags and Confluence macro elements into a specific expanded format, handling CDATA sections, namespace conversions, and macro conversions.

classes.name: DetailsToExpand
classes.description: A class for converting Confluence markup content to an expanded HTML format, handling namespace conversions, CDATA extraction, and macro transformation logic.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Main method that converts input HTML content, handling namespace modifications, CDATA sections, and transforming 'details' macro elements into expanded form.

methods.name: findSummary
methods.description: Finds and returns the 'summary' child element within a given DOMElement, or null if not found.

methods.name: isWithinCodeBlock
methods.description: Checks if a given DOMElement is located within a code macro block, to avoid processing code blocks.

methods.name: convertOne
methods.description: Converts a single macro element (specifically <ac:structured-macro>) into an expanded form with a title and body, used within the main convert process.
